description: List iOS apps that once charted and have disappeared from the App Store, biggest revenue first, updated daily. Each item has the name, developer, category, best chart rank and the store it reached it in, the worldwide monthly revenue and downloads estimates from before the removal (5000 or less means under 5K), first release and last update dates, removed_on (the day we found it gone, not the day Apple acted), restored_on when it came back, and developer_gone when Apple lists no live apps from that developer. The answer also gives totals for the whole list. Needs an active Social Growth Engineers subscription; other keys are refused.

category.description: App Store category name, e.g. "Games", "Finance". An unknown name is refused and the error lists the valid ones

country.description: Two-letter code of the store where the app reached its best rank

developer_gone.description: Only apps whose developer has no live apps left

dir.description: Sort direction. Default: biggest, best rank, most recent or A to Z, to suit the sort

offset.description: Apps to skip, for the next page (use next_offset)

query.description: Words in the app's or developer's name (at most 200 characters)

status.description: gone: still missing. back: returned to the store

name: get_removed_apps
title: Get removed apps
